protocol: ResNet-50 ImageNet, 15 epochs, batch 32, AdamW lr 3e-4 wd 1e-4, cosine; best epoch by validation macro-F1; seeds 42-46; only the listed factor differs from C0. Validation is used for epoch selection AND reporting (same optimistic bias for every method).
sd: sample SD (ddof=1) across seeds; the earlier cls_summary.md used population SD (ddof=0)

C0r.label: C0r baseline re-run (same code as new runs)
C0r.change_vs_C0: identical to C0; re-run to check reproducibility and save probabilities

I_sampler.label: A weighted sampler
I_sampler.change_vs_C0: sampler p ~ n_c^-0.5, plain cross-entropy (no class weights)

C3b_oversample_baselineaug.label: B oversampling
C3b_oversample_baselineaug.change_vs_C0: duplicate minority crops to min(3n, sqrt(n_max n)); class weights kept; longer epochs

I_focal.label: C focal loss
I_focal.change_vs_C0: focal loss gamma 2, no class weights

I_minority_geom.label: E minority-only geometric aug
I_minority_geom.change_vs_C0: baseline aug + rotation 5 deg / shift 3% / scale 0.95-1.05 for Deep Caries & Periapical Lesion only
